results.analysis_summary:
**Probability:** Jakub Mensik 25.7% | Grigor Dimitrov 74.3%
**Fair ML:** Jakub Mensik +289 | Grigor Dimitrov -289
**DR:** Jakub Mensik 1.8991 | Grigor Dimitrov 1.9742
**Edge vs Market:** +12.3%
Mensik must maintain 65%+ first-serve to neutralize Dimitrov's return. Dimitrov's backhand slice stays lower on grass than almost any shot — challenges Mensik's 6'3" frame. Contrarian play: if Mensik's serve dominates, tiebreak variance favors underdog.
results.sharp_consensus: Sharp money firmly backs Dimitrov on experience. Mensik ML is a heavy contrarian fade. If Mensik serves above 65% first-serve, he can force tiebreaks where variance favors the underdog.
results.umpire_notes: Lenient chair (fast rhythm) favors Mensik's quick-strike ability. Strict clock enforcement could disrupt Mensik's service routine in high-pressure moments.
results.stylistic_edge: Grigor Dimitrov's court coverage neutralizes Jakub Mensik's power | Jakub Mensik's bigger serve (88/100) dictates | Grigor Dimitrov's return is the X-factor

results.analysis_summary:
**Probability:** Karen Khachanov 86.1% | Yannick Hanfmann 13.9%
**Fair ML:** Karen Khachanov -621 | Yannick Hanfmann +621
**DR:** Karen Khachanov 2.0563 | Yannick Hanfmann 1.5255
**Edge vs Market:** +14.1%
Khachanov's flat groundstrokes penetrate grass perfectly. Hanfmann's kick serve sits up into Khachanov's strike zone. Khachanov 80% first-serve points won on grass. Hanfmann BP conversion drops significantly on faster surfaces.
results.sharp_consensus: Sharp consensus heavily backs Khachanov. Hanfmann lacks flat finishing power to hit through Khachanov on grass. Solid favorite play.
results.umpire_notes: Khachanov prefers steady, methodical rhythm. An umpire who doesn't rush his service routine helps him maintain high first-serve percentage.

results.analysis_summary:
**Probability:** Kamil Majchrzak 78.7% | Zachary Svajda 21.3%
**Fair ML:** Kamil Majchrzak -370 | Zachary Svajda +370
**DR:** Kamil Majchrzak 1.8138 | Zachary Svajda 1.4557
**Edge vs Market:** +19.7%
Majchrzak's backhand down the line is his most profitable shot on grass. Svajda stands far back to return — easily punished by spot serving. Svajda still developing reliable grass movement patterns.
results.sharp_consensus: Sharps view Majchrzak's surface comfort as the deciding factor. Distinct value against Svajda who lacks grass-court reliability.
results.umpire_notes: Strict 25-second clock heavily pressures Svajda who grinds long rallies and needs recovery time. Benefits Majchrzak's quicker pace.

results.analysis_summary:
**Probability:** Matteo Berrettini 62.3% | Arthur Fils 37.7%
**Fair ML:** Matteo Berrettini -165 | Arthur Fils +165
**DR:** Matteo Berrettini 2.2795 | Arthur Fils 2.0253
**Edge vs Market:** -2.7%
Both players serve 130+ mph — breaks are statistically rare. Berrettini's serve virtually impenetrable on grass when healthy. Fils has raw power to snatch a set via tiebreak or singular loose game. Match likely extends to 4 sets minimum.
results.sharp_consensus: Over 3.5 Sets is highly backed by sharps. Both players hold serve at elite levels. Fils can take a set but lacks consistency to win 3.
results.umpire_notes: Strict time violations could rattle younger Fils in high-pressure moments, potentially extending match if he drops focus.
results.stylistic_edge: Arthur Fils's court coverage neutralizes Matteo Berrettini's power

**DR:** Jaume Munar 1.4432 | Jacob Fearnley 1.5279

results.sharp_consensus: Sharps note Fearnley wildcard hype is overpriced. Munar's baseline consistency and stamina can force less-experienced Fearnley into overhitting. Direct fade on British hype.

results.analysis_summary:

**Fair ML:** Alexander Bublik -1482 | Kyrian Jacquet +1482
**DR:** Alexander Bublik 2.0943 | Kyrian Jacquet 1.3253
**Edge vs Market:** +11.7%
Bublik hits aces at elite rate, uses underarm serves and drops to disrupt. Jacquet lacks weapons to consistently threaten elite servers. Only risk: Bublik's notorious mid-match focus drops.
results.sharp_consensus: Bublik ML is heavily juiced chalk — strictly a parlay piece. Raw talent gap over Jacquet on grass is immense.
